One app, two seasons

Designed for the journey from expecting to arrived.

Aegi quietly shifts with you. Track pregnancy week by week, then move into newborn life with feeds, sleep, and diapers — without learning a new app.

Expecting

For the waiting months.

Track your pregnancy week by week, log vitals and movement, and time contractions when the day arrives.

  • Weekly progress and due-date countdown
  • Contraction timer with averages
  • Kick counter
  • Daily logs for mood, weight, water, supplements
Arrived

Quickly log feeds, diapers, and sleep, see honest weekly trends, and save the memories you want to keep.

Features

Everything you reach for, quietly in one place.

Aegi is built around a small set of essentials. No noisy dashboards, no upsells — just the things you actually use day to day.

Pregnancy overview

See your week, fruit-size milestones, due date, and the daily logs that matter — all on one calm screen.

Contraction timer

Tap start and stop. Aegi shows your duration, intervals, and a clear history when you need to share it.

Kick counter

A simple ten-tap counter for kick sessions, with the time and date saved for your own peace of mind.

Feed, diaper & sleep

Log breast, expressed, or formula feeds, wet and dirty diapers, and naps in a couple of taps.

Trends & timeline

Weekly trends for feeds and sleep, plus an honest, scannable timeline of the day's activity.

Memory journal

Write down the small moments — first smiles, sleepy cuddles, days you don't want to forget — with simple tags.

A closer look

Quiet screens that get out of your way.

Newborn dashboard

The day, at a glance — without the noise.

Feeds, sleep, wet, dirty. The four things you actually need to know in the first weeks, surfaced before anything else.

  • Most recent activity with relative time
  • One-tap to log from the home screen
  • Switch to a daily summary view any time
Pregnancy mode

Week by week, without the clutter.

See your current week and due date next to the daily inputs that matter — water, weight, mood, supplements, and blood pressure.

  • Weekly milestone and fruit-size cue
  • Five quick-log cards on the home screen
  • A full timeline of every entry you've made
When the day arrives

A contraction timer and kick counter that just work.

Tap once to start. Aegi keeps your durations and intervals, and gives you a clean history you can share with your provider.

  • Live timer with average duration and interval
  • Ten-tap kick counter with timer
  • Gentle reminder to consult your medical provider
Memory journal

The moments you'll want to read again.

A journal that doesn't feel like a feed. Write a sentence, add a tag, come back when you need to remember how this felt.

  • Dated entries with simple, soft tags
  • Long-form writing with serif typography
  • Quiet, distraction-free reading view
Why Aegi

Made to be the calmest app on your home screen.

We built Aegi to disappear into your day. Whether you're three days from a due date or three weeks into newborn life, logging shouldn't feel like another job to do.

  • 01

    Easy daily logging

    Most entries are two taps. The hardest screen in the app is the one you almost never need.

  • 02

    A calm visual experience

    Soft palette, generous whitespace, a serif used only where it earns its place — nothing competing for your eyes.

  • 03

    Across pregnancy and newborn stages

    One profile, one app. Switch between expecting and arrived modes when life shifts — no migration required.

  • 04

    Tracking, not diagnosis

    Aegi helps you record and organize. It isn't a medical device and doesn't replace your care team.

Aegi is for tracking and organization only. Contraction, pregnancy, and baby features are informational and are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition. Always consult your healthcare provider.
